verdict.line: You win the trade and the kill race whenever Gwen's W (Hallowed Mist) is down, but the 44.4% win rate over 516 games shows she stalls behind it often enough to erase that edge.

brief.thesis: Illaoi's entire kit past level 3 is targeted — W (Harsh Lesson) leaps to a target, E (Test of Spirit) rips a spirit from a target — and Gwen's W (Hallowed Mist) makes her untargetable by anything cast from outside the mist. When her mist is on cooldown you have straight lane and solo-kill advantage; when it's up she can sit in it, poke with Q, and refuse the fight entirely. The whole lane is a fight over that one cooldown, not a stat check.

theirWindow.when: Hallowed Mist is up and she's near it
theirWindow.what: She'll plant the mist and poke with Q (Snip Snip!) from inside it. You physically cannot target her with W or E from outside, so don't walk in chasing a trade — you'll eat the true-damage center of her Q cone and her passive's healing for free.

yourWindow.when: Mist was just used or is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Go immediately. Land E (Test of Spirit) to start the vessel timer, follow with W (Harsh Lesson) to leap in and wake nearby Tentacles, and use R (Leap of Faith) if she's grouped with a jungler for the AoE hit plus extra Tentacle spawn. This is the only window she can't escape or deny you in.

powerCurve.note: Only Q up for both, no leap or spirit yet
E online, all-in threat before her mist matters
R adds AoE burst plus free Tentacle spawns
Q cooldown shrinks to 4.25-3.5s, passive stacks hurt

start.why: 45.9% win rate over 366 games and the highest pick rate at 57.9% — the extra sustain matters because you're trading autos and Q tentacle procs before E comes online at level 3, and Gwen's passive already punishes you for standing in melee range.

boots.why: 44.3% win rate over 359 games, 63.5% pick — Gwen's damage is entirely magic (Q, R, passive on-hit) and the tenacity shortens how long her E (Skip 'n Slash) attack-speed window sticks to you.

core.why: Opens the strongest measured path (56.5% win rate with Iceborn Gauntlet into Sterak's Gage) and the armor shred matters since you still need to physically stick a target once she leaves mist.
Part of the 56.5% win-rate line — the slow on proc keeps her in W/E range during the all-in window instead of letting her kite out with E's attack-speed buff.
Completes the top-performing build path and gives the HP buffer to survive her passive's percent-health magic damage during extended trades.
Common fourth item across all three measured paths — directly answers her magic damage and the lifesteal she gets off her passive on-hit.

situational.when: she's ahead and threatening to burst you down in the all-in window
you'd rather blunt her Q and on-hit autos directly over the magic resist and tenacity of Mercury's Treads

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest-performing page at 39.5% win rate and 33.7% pick — it turns melee trades into HP gain in a lane you're going to be fighting for over the whole game, not just in the burst window her mist denies you.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the best measured combo at 48.8% win rate (19.7% pick) and it's built for exactly this matchup — it converts your solo-kill advantage into an actual kill the moment her mist goes down, instead of just a shoved wave. If you'd rather play the mist standoff more patiently, Exhaust+Flash (46.4% win rate, 29.2% pick) is the safer alternative.

playing.title: Bait the mist before you commit
playing.detail: Trade an auto or a Q tentacle proc to force her to burn W (Hallowed Mist) defensively, then wait out its 22/21/20/19/18s cooldown before you commit E or W.

playing.title: Never chase into an active mist
playing.detail: You cannot target her with W or E from outside the mist. Walking in just puts you in range of her Q's true-damage center and her healing passive for nothing.

playing.title: All-in the instant mist is down
playing.detail: E (Test of Spirit) to start the vessel clock, then W (Harsh Lesson) to leap and wake Tentacles. This is the one window she has no answer to.

playing.title: Track her E dash before you fight
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash refunds its 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s cooldown only on hit. If she whiffs it to reposition, her stick and burst window is gone — that's your cue to force the fight.

playing.title: Don't facetank her Q for free
playing.detail: The center of her Snip Snip! cone deals true damage in addition to the magic damage on the rest of the cone. Close the trade fast with your own damage instead of standing in extended range of it.

playing.title: Use vessels to threaten the map, not just the duel
playing.detail: If you land E and she disengages rather than trade it out, the Tentacle zone left behind still pressures the wave and any dive or objective play nearby.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, rune pages, boots, and summoner win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.18.1) via OP.GG — the mist-denial read on why the matchup plays the way it does is my own tactical judgement, not part of that data.
